title: NeXT Cube product photograph
provenance_type: historical source (third-party licensed photograph of a museum-held NeXTcube)
shared_version: not_applicable (archive still; no shared template used)

outputs.role: editorial frame 1920x1080 (derived: scaled + matted, no crop)
historical original (native JPEG, byte-identical to the Wikimedia Commons original)

variants.name: editorial-frame
variants.notes: Scale 0.270000, offset [150, 0], matte RGB [255, 255, 255]; no crop. Still: hold for editorial timing.

credits.credit: Photograph by Rama & Musée Bolo, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0 FR (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/fr/). Framed for video (scaled, matted; no crop).
credits.license: CC BY-SA 2.0 FR (author also offers CeCILL)

tests.test: original integrity against the Commons record
tests.detail: source/original.jpg SHA-1 5be8d8b7c95f6ae28f0e2144d170a713fac8a77b equals the Commons API sha1; 897959 bytes; JPEG magic present. SHA-256 a96d0970265fe853715b6871a8db045707f7e8a36d7c975710319a93d627530d is identical for the downloaded file and the repo copy.

tests.test: framing is uniform scale, no crop, seamless matte
tests.detail: Scale 0.27 (6000x4000 -> 1620x1080), offset (150,0). Original's outer border is RGB 255 on every channel; both 20 px seam strips in the export are min=max=255, so the matte join is invisible. Nothing from the original is removed.

tests.test: content position against the shared safe area
tests.detail: Non-white equipment bbox (303,62)-(1609,1034). The monitor top passes y=72 by 10 px and the keyboard bottom passes y=1008 by 26 px. The safe area governs essential text; this still carries no text, so it is left unscaled to keep the photograph as large as possible. An editor wanting clearance can scale the still by ~94% in the edit.

tests.full_size: Viewed source/original.jpg (6000x4000, displayed downscaled) and exports/editorial-frame.png (1920x1080). Black NeXT cube with NeXT logo badge, NeXT display, French AZERTY NeXT keyboard and mouse on white. Nothing is cut off; no watermark, caption, UI, people, or private information. Aspect ratio preserved.
tests.one_to_one: Viewed a 400x240 1:1 crop of the export around the cube logo, feet and mouse: logo edges and colours crisp, no ringing, halos or blocking from resampling.
tests.proof_720: Viewed proofs/editorial-frame-720.png (1280x720): the cube, its grille and logo, and the display remain clearly recognisable; keyboard legends are not meant to be read and are not.

tests.detail: Searched every file in the asset folder for the local account name, home-directory paths and the user's email address.
git status lists changes only under assets/historical/HIST-14/; sources/ and War/SCRIPT.md untouched.

toolchain.acquisition: python urllib GET from upload.wikimedia.org with Retry-After backoff; SHA-1 checked against Commons API

notes: Editorial still only; no text, UI, or annotation is added to the photograph.
Review questions HIST-14-Q1..Q3 are in evidence/claim-checks.json.
